note: Groceries and Energy: BLS Average Price Data, January values (series id = BLS/FRED id). Electronics: U.S. launch/list MSRP, one product line per series; pts are [year, price, product, month, source URL]; `src` says where the prices come from (Wikipedia when absent); `who` names the line in the inflation fact (default "Console prices"). Subscriptions: U.S. list price after each change, same row layout with product null; the newest row is today's price. Cars: automaker base MSRP of the cheapest version of each model year, before the destination fee; pts are [model year, price, version, month announced, source URL]. Fast food: The Economist's Big Mac index U.S. price (CC BY 4.0), the first survey of each year plus the newest one. Metals: World Bank Pink Sheet monthly average price per troy ounce (gold, silver); rounds are January every 5 years from 1975, and the last row is the newest month. `ended` marks a product line no longer sold (the year it stopped); the top ticker leaves those out. Housing: U.S. Census Bureau/HUD median sales price of new houses sold (FRED MSPUS), first quarter of each year, last row the newest quarter. Services: official list prices after each change (USPS first-class stamp, NYC subway base fare); `steps` marks lines whose price holds flat between changes. `prior` on a BLS series names an older BLS id for the same product whose Januaries fill earlier years.
